legend: Today the $$$n^2$$$ contestants of EUC have gathered outside the venue to take a drone photo. Jennifer, the social media manager for the event, has arranged them into an $$$n\times n$$$ square. Being very good at her job, she knows that the contestant standing on the intersection of the $$$i$$$-th row with the $$$j$$$-th column is $$$a_{i,j}$$$ years old. Coincidentally, she notices that no two contestants have the same age, and that everyone is between $$$1$$$ and $$$n^2$$$ years old.

Jennifer is planning to have some contestants hold a banner with the ICPC logo parallel to the ground, so that it is clearly visible in the aerial picture. Here are the steps that she is going to follow in order to take the perfect EUC drone photo.
First of all, Jennifer is going to select four contestants standing on the vertices of an axis-aligned rectangle.
Then, she will have the two younger contestants hold one of the poles, while the two older contestants will hold the other pole.
Finally, she will unfold the banner, using the poles to support its two ends. Obviously, this can only be done if the two poles are parallel and do not cross, as shown in the pictures below.

Being very indecisive, Jennifer would like to try out all possible arrangements for the banner, but she is worried that this may cause the contestants to be late for the competition. How many different ways are there to choose the four contestants holding the poles in order to take a perfect photo? Two choices are considered different if at least one contestant is included in one but not the other.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2\le n \le 1500$$$).
The next $$$n$$$ lines describe the ages of the contestants. Specifically, the $$$i$$$-th line contains the integers $$$a_{i,1},a_{i,2},\ldots,a_{i,n}$$$ ($$$1\le a_{i,j}\le n^2$$$).

It is guaranteed that $$$a_{i,j}
eq a_{k,l}$$$ if $$$i
eq k$$$ or $$$j
eq l$$$.
output: Print the number of ways for Jennifer to choose the four contestants holding the poles.
note: In the first sample, there are $$$4$$$ contestants, arranged as follows.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d546103046d574eed55457072322fc4d14fa48b1.png)

There is only one way to choose four contestants, with one pole held by contestants aged $$$1$$$ and $$$2$$$ and the other one by contestants aged $$$3$$$ and $$$4$$$. But then, as we can see in the picture, the poles cross.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1b17e53062c04413ac2e22103e27126499116393.png)
Since there is no valid way to choose four contestants, the answer is $$$0$$$.
In the second sample, the $$$4$$$ contestants are arranged as follows.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/56a93c7230eb432a43828c0380a6316f3d0519f1.png)
Once again, there is only one way to choose four contestants, but this time the poles don't cross.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52d1026b34935125e3f33df7a40e55fedd8965f7.png)
Therefore, the answer is $$$1$$$.
In the third sample, the $$$9$$$ contestants are arranged as follows.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbf791ae257ca64e0fe5f29e05cb16251e52196b.png)
There are $$$6$$$ ways of choosing four contestants so that the poles don't cross, as shown in the following pictures.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/44b6e0d2f1cd8712da75d7b60c1c3ce84f778741.png)

legend: 今天，EUC 的 $$$n^2$$$ 参赛者聚集在会场外拍摄无人机照片。活动的社交媒体经理珍妮弗把他们排成了一个 $$$n\times n$$$ 正方形。由于她的工作非常出色，她知道站在第 $$$i$$$ 行和第 $$$j$$$ 列交叉点上的参赛者是 $$$a_{i,j}$$$ 岁。巧合的是，她注意到没有两个参赛者的年龄相同，每个人的年龄都在 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n^2$$$ 岁之间。
Jennifer 计划让一些参赛者举着印有 ICPC 标志的横幅，横幅与地面平行，以便在航拍照片中清晰可见。以下是她将采取的步骤，以拍摄完美的 EUC 无人机照片。
首先，詹妮弗要选出四名选手站在一个轴向矩形的顶点上。
然后，她会让两名年龄较小的选手握住其中一根杆子，而两名年龄较大的选手则握住另一根杆子。
最后，她将展开横幅，用杆子支撑其两端。显然，这只能在两极平行且不交叉的情况下实现，如下图所示。
珍妮弗非常优柔寡断，她想尝试所有可能的横幅安排，但她担心这样会导致参赛者在比赛中迟到。为了拍出一张完美的照片，有多少种不同的方法来选择手持杆子的四位参赛者？如果至少有一名参赛者参加了其中一种选择，而另一种选择没有参加，那么这两种选择就被认为是不同的。
input: 第一行包含单个整数 $$$n$$$($$$2\le n \le 1500$$$)。
接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行描述了参赛者的年龄。具体来说，$$$i$$$ 第三行包含整数 $$$a_{i,1},a_{i,2},\ldots,a_{i,n}$$$($$$1\le a_{i,j}\le n^2$$$)。

保证$$$a_{i,j}
eq a_{k,l}$$$如果$$$i
eq k$$$或$$$j
eq l$$$。
output: 打印出詹妮弗选择四名手拿杆子的选手的方法数。
note: 在第一个样本中，有 $$$4$$$ 参赛者，排列如下。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d546103046d574eed55457072322fc4d14fa48b1.png)
四名选手只有一种选择方式，年龄为$$$1$$$、$$$2$$$的选手持一杆，年龄为$$$3$$$、$$$4$$$的选手持一杆。但是，正如我们在图中看到的，两极交叉。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1b17e53062c04413ac2e22103e27126499116393.png)
由于没有有效的方法选出四位参赛者，所以答案是$$$0$$$。
在第二个样本中，$$$4$$$ 参赛者的排列如下。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/56a93c7230eb432a43828c0380a6316f3d0519f1.png)
再一次，只有一种方法可以选出四位参赛者，但这次两极不会交叉。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52d1026b34935125e3f33df7a40e55fedd8965f7.png)
在第三个样本中，$$$9$$$ 参赛者的排列如下。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbf791ae257ca64e0fe5f29e05cb16251e52196b.png)
有 $$$6$$$ 种方法来选择四名参赛者，以确保两极不会相交，如下图所示。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/44b6e0d2f1cd8712da75d7b60c1c3ce84f778741.png)
